source.author: stat
source.text: hic pariter lapsae iunctoque per ipsum amplexu miscent avidae lacrimasque comasque, partitaeque artus redeunt alterna gementes ad vultum et cara vicibus cervice fruuntur.
source.text_original: ' hic pariter lapsae iunctoque per ipsum / amplexu miscent avidae lacrimasque comasque, / partitaeque artus redeunt alterna gementes / ad vultum et cara vicibus cervice fruuntur.
source.text_english: Here alike, having fallen and joined in one embrace, they mingle eager tears and hair, and, though parted, they return with alternating groans to each other’s face and enjoy their dear necks in turns.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Zephyrumque ratemque morantis solverat amplexus tristi tuba tertia signo.
reuse.text_original: Zephyrumque ratemque morantis / solverat amplexus tristi tuba tertia signo.
reuse.text_english: and the third trumpet, with its sad signal, had released Zephyrus and the ship from their delaying embrace
